title: Bronze Account: Why did my interest rate change?
summary: This document explains why a Bronze Account’s interest rate/APY can change due to APY updates (interest earns at the current APY), daily compounding effects, and Rho-Bank credit card APY bonuses (Platinum Rewards Card +0.55% APY; Diamond Elite Card +0.15%). It also instructs customers to confirm the currently applicable APY in account details (example: 2.0%) and compare today’s APY/credited interest and average daily balance with prior statements, noting the statement period for support review.
faqs: What causes my Bronze Account interest rate or APY to change?
